purpose: check of review finding A1 (2026-10-09) on stored solutions; no correction, no re-optimisation
caveat: at held set points the corrected-cascade gains are NOT a new coupling gain (that needs a re-optimisation of the set points); they estimate the effect of the check on the reported solutions

profiles.model: sensible to T_kalt, then all latent heat at T_kalt (as evaluate_cascade)
profiles.physical: condensation from the dew point on: q(T) = C (T_out - T) + m max(0, Y - Y_s(T)) dh_v(T_kalt)

modes.as_run_20K: warm end only, model profile, dT_min 20 K (the cascade of the runs)
modes.as_run_10K: warm end only, model profile, dT_min 10 K (reference)
modes.along_20K: minimum along the exchanger >= 20 K, physical profile
modes.along_10K: minimum along the exchanger >= 10 K, physical profile

variants.fixed: the stored interconnection of each solution
variants.best: the best of the 441 interconnections at the held set points

rule: G_s = best S2 - M3'(seed s), G = min over the seeds (Befund 77); n_W counts G >= 1.0 kg/h
